Ruling: batch #152 item 5 · letter 1 (converge the bare `dashboard` key on `plugin-dashboard` — the package registers `plugin-dashboard:dashboard`, the console's lazy stubs are then satisfied, `view:dashboard` retires with a by-name tombstone and the docs row follows; ownership pinned in both registration orders) · maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-09-18T03:59Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **1**; the maintainer agreed. Facts (this card; triage 5708928571; seat census on today's trees): two console `registerLazy` calls claim bare `dashboard` for `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` (`preview-gallery.tsx:36`, `register-plugins.ts:65`) — through the door with no collision check — while the package itself registers `view:dashboard` (`plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:79`); which full name a host gets depends on whether the chunk has loaded. `register()` clears only the stub of the type it registers, so the `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` stub is never cleared, `hasLazy('dashboard','plugin-dashboard')` stays true forever, and the generated CLI whitelist (`known-schema-types.ts:644`) advertises a spelling that can never resolve. Who writes the two spellings: `view:dashboard` in 8 objectui files (the docs row `plugin-dashboard.mdx:99`, the whitelist, the renderer's comment, the checks) and `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` in 5; objectstack, hotcrm and cloud author neither. objectui#6416 converged `plugin-report` off exactly this shape.

## Ruling — **1**

- `packages/plugin-dashboard` registers `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` (namespace `plugin-dashboard`), which clears the console stubs on load; the `view` namespace registration goes, and an authored `view:dashboard` is **refused by name** with a tombstone pointing at `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` (⛔ not a silent fall-through). `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx:99` and the CLI whitelist regenerate; `check-registry-bare-name-collisions.mjs`'s row for this pair goes.
- Ownership pin in both orders, the `report-bare-key-ownership.test.ts` / `timeline-bare-key-ownership.test.ts` technique: eager-then-lazy and lazy-then-eager both resolve bare `dashboard` to the one full name, and `hasLazy` is false after the package loads.
- The objectui#9264 shrink-only ledger loses this row — the fix is the ledger shrinking, ⛔ not prose.
- Published full name narrows ⇒ `Clause-②: yes` in the changeset (minor, 「Breaking for authored metadata」 naming the tombstone); `domain:ui` — no at-tier review outside the spec/skills lanes (batch #151 item 3).
- ⛔ **2** — leaves the whitelist advertising a dead spelling; ⛔ **3** — resolves the contest and not the unsatisfiable stub.

Four-facet reading: ① an author's `{ "type": "dashboard" }` resolves the same way whenever it is asked; ② one namespace, the same as every sibling plugin; ③ an auto-generated whitelist advertising a dead spelling is the hardest doc error to notice — this removes it; ④ the established remedy, no new mechanism.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:ui`, `priority:p2`, `bug` stay. Before acting the claimant reproduces the never-cleared stub against a real `Registry` (the card's own instruction) — the conclusion was read off the clearing lines, not executed.

Director seat, summon #24, batch **#152 item 5 letter 1**, maintainer 「其他同意」 at 2026-09-18T03:59Z (comment `5724939774`). ⛔ Do not re-open the three routes; **2** and **3** were rejected with reasons on the record. Execute letter **1**.

## Re-read on `main` at `0ee6e316e` — every site in the ruling is still where it says

| probe | reading |
|---|---|
| console claimant 1 | `apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx:36` `ComponentRegistry.registerLazy(variant, …)`, `:37` `namespace: 'plugin-dashboard'` |
| console claimant 2 | `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:65` `registerLazy`, `:66` `namespace: 'plugin-dashboard'` |
| the package's own | `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:79` `ComponentRegistry.register('dashboard', DashboardRenderer, {` with `:83` `namespace: 'view'` |
| ⭐ the generated whitelist advertises **all three** spellings | `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts:98` `'dashboard'` · `:300` `'plugin-dashboard:dashboard'` · `:649` `'view:dashboard'` |

⚠️ I went looking for a falsified premise here and did **not** find one: my first probe missed `:83` because the `register(` call and its `namespace` sit on different lines, and I re-read rather than reporting a contradiction that was my own grep's. ⇒ the card and the ruling are accurate; ⛔ do not inherit a doubt I resolved.

## ⛔ YOUR FIRST ACT IS A REPRODUCTION, and both the card and the ruling say so

> Before acting the claimant reproduces the never-cleared stub against a real `Registry` (the card's own instruction) — the conclusion was read off the clearing lines, not executed.

⇒ **Execute it.** `register()` clears the stub of the type **it** registers; the package registers `view:dashboard`; so `hasLazy('dashboard', 'plugin-dashboard')` is claimed to stay `true` forever. That is read off source, ⛔ not observed. If the live registry disagrees, that is a **full success** — report it and stop; the ruling rests on it.

⛔ **Import order is NOT the verdict either.** The finding is "two declarations claim this name", ⛔ not "declaration A wins today". objectui#6416's pin exists because *"asserting only today's resolved outcome cannot tell 'declared' apart from 'happened to be observed after the right step'"*.

## What letter 1 requires, verbatim from the ruling

- `packages/plugin-dashboard` registers **`plugin-dashboard:dashboard`** (namespace `plugin-dashboard`), which clears the console stubs on load; the `view` namespace registration **goes**.
- An authored `view:dashboard` is **refused BY NAME** with a tombstone pointing at `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` — ⛔ **not a silent fall-through**.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx:99` and the CLI whitelist **regenerate**; `check-registry-bare-name-collisions.mjs`'s row for this pair goes.
- Ownership pinned in **both orders**, the `report-bare-key-ownership.test.ts` / `timeline-bare-key-ownership.test.ts` technique: eager-then-lazy **and** lazy-then-eager both resolve bare `dashboard` to the one full name, and `hasLazy` is `false` after the package loads.
- ⭐ **The objectui#9264 shrink-only ledger loses this row — the fix IS the ledger shrinking, ⛔ not prose.** A diff that edits the ledger's text instead of shortening it has not done the card.

## ⛔ Clause-②: `yes` — declared by the ruling, and it is a NARROWING

The ruling: 「Published full name narrows ⇒ `Clause-②: yes` in the changeset (minor, 「Breaking for authored metadata」 naming the tombstone)」. ⇒ the changeset carries that declaration in those terms.

⚠️ Note what makes this unusual and ⛔ do not let it confuse your measurement: the accept set **narrows** (an authored `view:dashboard` stops resolving), and it is `yes` anyway, because the **published full name moves**. ⭐ So the mechanical floor `^\+export` is useless here in both directions — count it, and say what it does not prove, the way a sibling delivery did well this shift and another got wrong.

**You are not blocked by this and ⛔ you do not wait on it.** Build at the default tier. Arranging the contract review is mine. ⚠️ And an honest note so you can read the record later: the ruling states 「no at-tier review outside the spec/skills lanes (batch #151 item 3)」 while `contract-review.md:53` says an off-tier seat must discharge by an at-tier subagent. **Those conflict**, objectstack#18885 owns the conflict, and this seat takes the stricter of the two. ⛔ None of that is yours to resolve.

## ⛔ Hard constraints

- ⛔ **Do not re-litigate the ruling.** If execution turns up a fact that contradicts it, **stop and report** — that is a new decision, ⛔ not a licence to pick route 2 or 3.
- ⛔ **Do not add a collision check to `registerLazy`.** Triage notes it has none while `register` warns, and that this shape came in through the unguarded door. ⭐ True, interesting, and a **different card** — report it, ⛔ do not build it.
- ⛔ objectui `AGENTS.md:316`: never `git push --force` or `--force-with-lease`, never push to `main`. Absolute, and ⛔ **not** tiered by seat.
- ⚠️ Scope-pinned card ⇒ AGENTS.md #11's opportunistic citation repair does **not** apply.

## The pin

Both orders, as the ruling requires, plus the stub: after the package loads, `hasLazy('dashboard', 'plugin-dashboard')` is **false**; bare `dashboard` resolves to the one full name from **either** registration order; and an authored `view:dashboard` is **refused by name**, with the tombstone naming its replacement. ⭐ The refusal is the assertion most easily faked — assert the refusal **and** the tombstone's text, ⛔ not merely the absence of a render.

## Serial constraints cleared

`apps/console/src/`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/`, `packages/cli/src/utils/`, `content/docs/plugins/`. No open PR of mine touches any of them: objectui#9464 is in `app-shell/views/metadata-admin/`, objectui#9497 in `app-shell/views/metadata-admin/clientValidation.ts`, PR objectui#9797 in `components`/`plugin-view`/`types`, PR objectui#9798 in `fields`. ⚠️ ⛔ `packages/types` is NOT yours here — if the tombstone pushes you into it, stop and report: PR objectui#9797 is awaiting its contract review on that package's surface. Merge `main` before opening your PR.

## Return

The live-`Registry` reproduction (or its falsification), both ownership orders green, the refusal **and** its tombstone text asserted, the objectui#9264 ledger row **gone** rather than edited, the `clause_2` field with what the floor does and does not prove, and any premise of mine you falsified. ⚠️ Fifteen of my premises have been falsified by lanes in four shifts. **A clean stop is a full success.**
